title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Xcubated Business Solutions (XBS) is a global consulting and technology firm composed of experienced professionals with multi-industry and multi-cultural backgrounds. The company partners with clients to design and implement future-ready solutions across advisory services, digital transformation, global delivery centers, and next-generation innovations. XBS delivers capabilities in areas such as IT strategy, business process consulting, digital platforms, automation, and IT service management tools. The organization also focuses on advanced technologies including big data, deep learning, AI/ML, cybersecurity automation, and immersive experiences, while supporting clients with mentorship, go-to-market collaboration, and cloud infrastructure services. This broad portfolio provides opportunities for technical experts to work on complex, high-impact projects across industries.

**Role Description**

 𝗠𝗶𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘀𝗼𝗳𝘁 𝗙𝗮𝗯𝗿𝗶𝗰 • 𝗦𝗻𝗼𝘄𝗳𝗹𝗮𝗸𝗲 • 𝗣𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗿 𝗕𝗜

We’re looking for a senior Data Engineer to own the transition from an existing Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture to Snowflake, with Power BI remaining the reporting layer.

The first priority:

𝗿𝗲𝗳𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝗮𝗯𝗿𝗶𝗰 𝗲𝗻𝘃𝗶𝗿𝗼𝗻𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗺𝗮𝗸𝗲 𝗶𝘁 𝗺𝗶𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻-𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆, while keeping business-critical Finance reporting stable and performant.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁

𝘆𝗼𝘂’𝗹𝗹 𝗼𝘄𝗻:

• Assess the current Fabric landscape and identify technical debt, platform dependencies and migration blockers.

• Refactor ingestion, transformation and orchestration, with consistent naming, data types and modelling standards.

• Define and document the target architecture and phased Snowflake migration roadmap.

• Strengthen the gold layer using

𝗞𝗶𝗺𝗯𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝗱𝗶𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴: star schemas, conformed dimensions and SCDs.

• Maintain Power BI performance and continuity throughout the transition.

• Improve security, governance, DEV/TEST/PRD deployments and

𝗖𝗜/𝗖𝗗 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗔𝘇𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗢𝗽𝘀.

• Align business, IT and platform teams, flag risks early and guide users on modelling best practices.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁

𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗯𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴:

 

𝟳+ 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀 𝗶𝗻 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗮 & 𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗹𝘆𝘁𝗶𝗰𝘀, with deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, Azure and Power BI experience.

 A proven track record in

𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗽𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺 𝗺𝗶𝗴𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀.

Strong lakehouse and cloud data warehouse knowledge, plus Snowflake experience or the ability to ramp up quickly.

 Expertise in enterprise-scale dimensional and semantic modelling.

 A proactive mindset,clear communication and confidence explaining technical trade-offs to business

stakeholders.

Experience with medallion architecture migrations, Centers ofExcellence, governance or training is a plus.

title: Advisory Solutions Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Your Role and Responsibilities
  
  
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

title: Senior Data Engineer(5+ years)
description:
We are looking for a Senior/Lead Data Engineer to build scalable batch and real-time data pipelines, develop robust data platforms, and leverage GenAI to automate and optimize data engineering workflows.

Must-Have Skills

5–10 years of experience in Data Engineering, including 2+ years in a senior/lead role. Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, Shell scripting, and Scala/PySpark.

Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, data modelling, and data warehousing. Experience with AWS services such as S3, Redshift, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, and EC2. Experience with Git/GitHub, CI/CD, and production data platforms.

Practical experience using GenAI/LLM tools to automate or accelerate engineering tasks.

Good-to-Have Skills

Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG pipelines, and AI agents. Familiarity with Airflow, dbt, Docker, and Kubernetes.

Exposure to Azure or GCP.

Knowledge of AI governance, data security, and quality guardrails.

Strong technical leadership, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

What We Offer

Opportunity to build AI-augmented data platforms and scalable data solutions. Work with GenAI technologies in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Collaborate with exceptional talent and contribute directly to business growth.
